讚美之泉
詞：鄭懋柔／曲：游智婷

lines.a: 我的盼望 就在耶穌基督裡
lines.b: All of my hope, lies in Jesus Christ alone

lines.a: 在祢裡面 滿有平安
lines.b: For I know that He is my peace

lines.a: 生命泉源 就在耶穌基督裡
lines.b: All of my joy, Lies in Jesus Christ alone
He lives in me forever more
Declare, the One who's within me
Is greater than the one in the world

lines.a: 我不屬這世界 我高舉耶穌的名
lines.b: I'm not of this world, I belong to Jesus, the King
Declare, the one who's within me
Is greater than the one in the world

lines.a: 有耶穌在我裡面活著 我勇敢站立
lines.b: I know that the King lives in me, I am strengthened in Him
My Lord, who lives in me

lines.a: 沒有懼怕 能戰勝仇敵

lines.b: My Lord, who lives in me

lines.a: 沒有懼怕 還得勝有餘
有耶穌在我裡面活著 我勇敢站立
lines.b: I know that the King lives in me, I am strengthened in Him
